hiw.title: HOW IT WORKS
hiw.subtitle1: Think of TrustChain as an unfakeable digital report card.
hiw.subtitle2: Usually, if a plumber or electrician does a great job, only the person who hired them knows. With TrustChain, every good job gets a "gold star" review that is locked in a public digital notebook (called a blockchain). No one can delete it, and no one can fake it.

step1.title: Get Your Digital Key
step1.desc: You don't need an email or a password. You just download a digital wallet (like Freighter). This acts as your unique key to log into TrustChain.

step2.title: Verify Your Identity
step2.desc: Verify your phone number with a one-time passcode. This ensures our platform remains spam-free and builds trust with employers.

step3.title: Do Great Work
step3.desc: Go out and do your job in the real world just like you normally do. Fix the pipe, build the wall, or paint the house.

step4.title: Collect Your Stars
step4.desc: After the job, the person who hired you gives you a rating. This rating is permanently glued to your digital profile so future customers can see how amazing you are.

step1.title: Find The Best People
step1.desc: Search through our list of workers. You can see what kind of jobs they do and what their overall score is.

step2.title: Trust The Reviews
step2.desc: Unlike normal websites where anyone can write fake 5-star reviews, every review on TrustChain is verified and locked. You know you are looking at real work history.

step3.title: Contact & Hire
step3.desc: Found the right worker? Click "Contact Worker" on their profile to reveal their phone number. Call them directly or message them on WhatsApp to discuss the job and hire them.

step4.title: Leave Your Review
step4.desc: When the worker finishes your job, leave a review. This rewards them for their hard work and helps the next person know they are reliable. Each review is sealed on the blockchain forever.

tech.title: Why is this safe and free?
tech.desc: TrustChain is built on top of a powerful computer network called Stellar. Think of Stellar as a giant, unbreakable digital safe. Once a review is put into the safe, nobody can change it or cheat the system. Best of all, we made it completely free to use—workers never have to pay money to collect their well-earned reviews.
